title: Executive request classification
description: The single request-classification vocabulary. Sole producer: M08 (ModelPort.classify output or trusted preflight, then the DECISION_RULES §3 policy pass). Consumers: M03, M04, M05, M06. M04 resolves references against it but never classifies intent; only M03 turns it into an InteractionDecision.

risk.description: Missing or out-of-vocabulary risk is replaced by the fail-closed classification (risk high, next_action escalate).

next_action.description: Recommendation after the M08 policy pass: the more restrictive of the model value and the route table (DECISION_RULES §3.2). Not a decision; M03 alone decides.
